mapper.sql: id, task_id, user_id, repayment_id, plan_id, overdue_level, overdue_days, priority, status, assigned_to, next_follow_date, promised_pay_date, promise_violated, last_follow_at, close_reason, closed_at, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collection_task (task_id, user_id, repayment_id, plan_id, overdue_level, overdue_days, priority, status, next_follow_date) SELECT #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{repaymentId}, #{planId}, #{overdueLevel}, #{overdueDays}, #{priority}, 'pending', #{nextFollowDate} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM collection_task WHERE repayment_id = #{repaymentId} AND status IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'promised') )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM collection_task WHERE repayment_id = #{repaymentId} AND status IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'promised') ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1

where.if: AND status IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'promised') AND next_follow_date IS NOT NULL AND next_follow_date <= CURDATE()

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM collection_task
ORDER BY priority ASC, overdue_days DESC, create_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.update:
UPDATE collection_task
assigned_to = #{assignedTo}, status = #{status}, next_follow_date = #{nextFollowDate},
promised_pay_date = #{promisedPayDate}, promise_violated = 0,
promise_violated = #{promiseViolated}, last_follow_at = NOW(),
WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status <> 'closed'
UPDATE collection_task SET status = 'closed', close_reason = #{reason}, closed_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status <> 'closed'
UPDATE collection_task SET status = 'closed', close_reason = #{reason}, closed_at = NOW() WHERE repayment_id = #{repaymentId} AND status IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'promised')
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.task_id, t.user_id, t.repayment_id, t.plan_id, t.overdue_level, t.overdue_days, t.priority, t.status, t.assigned_to, t.next_follow_date, t.promised_pay_date, t.promise_violated, t.last_follow_at, t.close_reason, t.closed_at, t.create_time, t.update_time FROM collection_task t INNER JOIN monthly_repayment mr ON t.repayment_id = mr.repayment_id WHERE t.promise_violated = 0 AND t.promised_pay_date IS NOT NULL AND t.promised_pay_date < CURDATE() AND t.status IN ('pending', 'in_progress', 'promised') AND mr.repayment_status IN ('unpaid', 'overdue') ORDER BY t.promised_pay_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE collection_task SET promise_violated = 1, priority = #{newPriority}, status = 'in_progress', next_follow_date = CURDATE() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND promise_violated = 0 AND status <> 'closed'
